content.name: Wholeness of Body
entries: You gain the ability to heal yourself. As an action, you can regain hit points equal to three times your monk level. You must finish a long rest before you can use this feature again.

content.name: Wholeness of Body
entries: You gain the ability to heal yourself. As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|SRD52}, you can roll your Martial Arts die. You regain a number of {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52} equal to the number rolled plus your Wisdom modifier (minimum of 1 {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52|Hit Point} regained).
You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of once), and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|SRD52}.
